description: Apply available OS updates (all, security-only, or a specific set of patch_ids) on a node, optionally reboot when required, then refresh the patchbot posture. The console reads the resulting posture via the patchbot fact on the next run. Dispatches to the POSIX (patch.sh) or Windows (patch.ps1) implementation automatically based on the target.

console_url.description: Console base URL (server-injected; unused by the patch itself).

ingest_token.description: Server-injected; unused by the patch itself.

security_only.description: Apply only security updates when true; otherwise apply all available updates. Ignored when patch_ids is set.

patch_ids.description: Install only these specific patch/package ids, as reported in the patchbot fact's patches[] array (KB numbers on Windows, package names on Linux). Takes priority over security_only when set. Must match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:+-]* -- rejected otherwise, since these are used unquoted on a package-manager command line running as root and a leading '-' or embedded whitespace would be read as a flag, not a package name.

reboot.description: Reboot the node afterward if a reboot is required.
